procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_270 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/chickasaw/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (15/15), including the two Court of Appeals Position 1 rows whose printed totals land on the same number (2807 each, an exact printed tie).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's 15 precincts (11 columns, then Sparta 012/Van Vleet 013/West Okolona 014/Woodland 015 + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the continuation rows and locals. The SEMS section-continuation split: 'Circuit Court 3-Circuit District 03 Place 1' prints as the LAST header box on p2/p3, and its candidate row (Gray Tollison) starts p4 ahead of the local zone -- the Warren p5 carry pattern. Chickasaw's Circuit 3 pairing matches Union's exactly (Place 1 Gray Tollison, Place 2 Bart M. Adams + Shirley C. Byers + Steven Patrick Jubera, Place 3 Kent E. Smith), independently corroborating the Benton late-header adjudication (Benton's sheet is the deviant print). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 01-District 1 Position 1 (Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr., John Weddle) and Position 2 (Donna M. Barnes) -- the same CoA 1 roster Union/Lee/Benton print; Chancery Court 14-1-Chancery District 14-1 (Rodney P. Faver, sole candidate); Circuit Court 3-Circuit District 03 Place 1 (Gray Tollison), Place 2 (Bart M. Adams, Shirley C. Byers, Steven Patrick Jubera), Place 3 (Kent E. Smith). Printed totals: Colom 3468, Hyde-Smith 2896, Pinkins 88, Baucom 85, Cliff Johnson 3272, Kelly 3046, Hopson 2807, Weddle 2807, D. Barnes 4892, Faver 4853, Tollison 4842, Adams 2478, Byers 2500, Jubera 475, Smith 4837.
operator_rows_note: All 15 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (four precinct cells + printed TOTAL) cells; Tollison/Adams/Byers/Jubera/Smith carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the fifteen precinct headers print complete with the county's SEMS precinct codes kept verbatim ('Anchor 001', 'Buena Vista 002', 'East Okolona 004', 'Egypt 003', 'North Houika 005', 'North Okolona 006', 'Northwest Houston 007', 'Pearsall 009', 'Pleasant Grove Thom 008', 'South Houika 011', 'Southeast Houston 010', 'Sparta 012', 'Van Vleet 013', 'West Okolona 014', 'Woodland 015' -- the sheet's own column order, codes out of sequence).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 3 Place 3: Chickasaw County School Board Dist 3/4 (Sharon Vance; Barbara Townsend Neal, Todd Whitfield) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery D14 note (accepted cross-county divergence, see accepted_roster_divergences): this county's portion of Chancery District 14 elects Place 1 only (Rodney P. Faver, sole candidate) while Noxubee's portion elects Place 3 only (Paula Drungole-Ellis, sole candidate) -- the disjoint place partition shape first adjudicated for Chancery District 9.

accepted_roster_divergences.note: Disjoint place partition across the district's counties: Chickasaw's recap prints Place 1 only (Rodney P. Faver); Noxubee's prints Place 3 only (Paula Drungole-Ellis). Each county keeps its own printed section; per-county TOTAL arithmetic verifies every row.
